text:
Kiran M: quick note from this morning

Ran a shadow pass of ember-13b (13B candidate) with q5_0 packing + latebind_window=128 on a small production slice. Throughput looked good but we saw some recall issues on long-context QA.\n\nLina S: good to know. numbers?\n\nKiran M: summary (median across 6 runs):\n```
- fp16 baseline: 11.2 tok/s
- q5_0: 18.9 tok/s
- q5_0 + latebind(128): 24.8 tok/s
- overall speedup vs fp16: ~2.21x
- 95p latency: baseline 480ms -> q5_0+latebind 520ms
```
\nConnor D: impressive perf. what about quality? any eval deltas?\n\nKiran M: ran our longform QA and a short RAG smokeset:
- longform QA (2k context holdout): EM down 1.7% abs vs fp16, error cluster on multi-hop with dispersed evidence.
- RAG smokeset: negligible diff for <512 context, slight hallucination increase on >1k context retrievals.
\nVikram R: did you isolate q5 vs latebind? could be latebind causing KV read timing/overlap issues.
\nKiran M: yes. ablations: q5_0 only (no latebind) retains most quality (EM down 0.4%), latebind-only (fp16 + latebind128) shows EM down 1.1%. so interaction seems multiplicative.
\nLina S: interesting. did you inspect token-level logits or attention alpha shift?\n\nConnor D: also check decoder cache lengths and eviction patterns. if latebind windows mismatch tokenization boundaries we might lose fringe tokens in KV stream.
\nKiran M: logged token-level KL against baseline across positions. tail positions >1024 show KL spikes when latebind enabled. attaching small plot in artifact.
\nqa-bench: automated run finished: job ember-shadow-2026-174314-01, artifacts at /runs/ember-shadow-174314-01.
\nLina S: propose the following next steps:
1) run \"kv-no-opt\" ablation: disable KV packing/merging to see if fidelity recovers.
2) try latebind_window=64 and 32 to find threshold where tail KL drops.
3) test q5_0 variant with higher mantissa smoothing (post-quant bias correction) to reduce drift.
4) add targeted probes that force long-span copy tasks (names, dates) across 1.5k contexts.
\nVikram R: +1 on targeted probes. I'll throw in a logits-diff inspector to dump per-token top-5 shift.
\nConnor D: also run beam k=3 and nucleus p=0.95 to see if sampling strategy mitigates short-answer bias.
\nKiran M: scheduling: I'll spin up experiments for (1)-(3) now, ETA ~8h. Vikram takes (4) and logits diffs. Connor will run sampling variants. Lina, can you own the pass/fail criteria?\n\nLina S: will define pass/fail: max EM drop tolerated 0.5% overall, and <1.0% on longform slice; hallucination delta measured by our 200-case precision test must be <1.0% absolute. I'll post criteria doc to /docs/ember-onboard/acceptance.md.
\ninfra-bot: reserved 6 workers on cluster-a100 (claim id infra-174314-02).
\nKiran M: thanks. if experiments show we can tune quant bias correction + latebind window to meet criteria, we can consider a 24h staging shadow. if not, we keep q5_0 or fall back to q4_k_m for now.
\nLina S: can we also capture deterministic seeds and tokenizer versions in every job? previous diffs got noisy because of tokenization changes.
\nKiran M: yep will include eval-config.json in each run (seed, tokenizer sha, model commit).
\nqa-bench: benchmark run queued: ember-shadow-174314-02 (targets: longform-probe-1k x200).
\nConnor D: cool. tagging @Vikram R for logits dumps and @Lina S for acceptance criteria once posted. :thumbsup:
\nKiran M: thanks all. will update with results later today.
